items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: We called Van to put it down on paper for her and Van made the arrangements. I had hired Van

ctx.x: Yeah. We were getting a little --
So I got Jimmy Mundy. I hired this boy, Van Alexander. He called himself Van. He used to be something else then.

items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: So I went out and met the music director -- the Commander (inaudible). And we got together (inaudible) -- straighten out all the parts and things (inaudible) for the big band.

ctx.x: What were your duties there? Pretty much as they were with Chick?

I did more there than I did with Chick, because Louie was a different type of man that Chick was, you know. You had to do everything. You had to call all the rehearsals, tell him what time you're gonna leave -- he didn't wanna know. Louie didn't want nothing. He was just -- this was Louie Armstrong and his band. Now, he's got a man that takes care of everything. Even when we did command performances in California and we did all the Coca-cola shows -- rehearsals. You call him just like you call the other…
performance and the band and so and so." He say, "Well go over and see my music director. I don't have anything to do with that."
